posts.title: Edge and WebView2 in Chrome DevTools MCP
posts.description: The Chrome DevTools MCP is very useful! Although it is the Chrome DevTools MCP, it supports connecting to pretty much all chromium based browsers. This includes Microsoft Edge and WebView2 with a bit of extra configuration in mcp.json .
